Symbol:

Type:
ara::core::Optional< std::uint8_t >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> pull;
Description:
std::uint8_t optinal member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined pull 3 bit header
field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype CRF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00...0x07 : valid
0x08...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set the value of pull to the configured value, if it is not be
provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
